free_tier.stated: none: the domain no longer serves a seedbox service. seeding.io is a CNAME to park.io and an HTTP request redirects to whoisbroker.com.

egress.terms: no service to assess; the host serves a domain-sale page

interface_detail: no interface: the domain is parked
chaining: removed from the candidate set; a parked domain cannot hold bytes or serve a retrieval path
binding_note: no constraint applies to a domain that serves no service

identity_cost.detail: not applicable; nothing can be registered

reliability_note: parked domain: HTTPS presents a certificate for a different principal name, and HTTP 302-redirects to whoisbroker.com
confidence_note: Measured by probe on 2026-10-23: DNS over HTTPS returned 'seeding.io CNAME park.io' and A 184.196.180.154; curl followed http://seeding.io/ to https://whoisbroker.com/ with 200; https://seeding.io/ failed TLS with SEC_E_WRONG_PRINCIPAL. The instrument was curl and Cloudflare DoH, not probe.py.

evidence.proved: DNS answer 'seeding.io. 60 IN CNAME park.io.'; HTTP 302 to https://whoisbroker.com/; TLS certificate name mismatch on the apex

notes: Recorded as dead rather than omitted so the next session does not spend a pass on it. If the domain is bought by a new operator, the record must be rechecked rather than trusted; a parked name proves nothing about a future service.

extras.probe_commands: DoH: curl 'https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query?name=seeding.io&type=A' -H 'accept: application/dns-json'; HTTP: curl -sSL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective} %{http_code}' http://seeding.io/
